# Anatomical illustration attribution

The underlying anatomical illustration is adapted from **Open-Source Anatomical Illustration for Digital Back Pain Documentation: Development and Evaluation** by Yanick X. Lukic et al.

- Source project: https://github.com/DigitalHealthZurich/open-pain-illustration
- Original SVG: https://github.com/DigitalHealthZurich/open-pain-illustration/blob/main/illustration/1.0/anatomical_illustration.svg
- Paper: https://preprints.jmir.org/preprint/75737
- Illustration license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0): https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Changes made for DitchmapR: added approximate translucent overlays to indicate broad 5-D Itch Scale locations. The overlays are schematic and have not been anatomically validated. The original illustration was designed for clinical pain documentation, not specifically for the 5-D Itch Scale. This adaptation does not imply endorsement by the original authors.
